{{Quote|This is the XR808g, flagship of JuunTaar Commercial, with two sister ships bearing supplies for the Jedi warriors. Please signal your intention to provide safe escort.|Jae Juun|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''JuunTaar Commercial''' was a fictional company used by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jae Juun]] while piloting his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the ''[[XR808g]]''. He sent a message via [[Mon Calamari blink code]] to the [[Killik]]s asking for safe passage.<ref name="JK" />
